snippet.title: Space Attack - Vic-20 - Real Hardware
snippet.description: I'm not sure which came out first (this was Oct 1982), but this Romik release (by Clifford Ramshaw) reminds me of Arcadia.  It's seems to be deficient in the collision detection department, and makes Arcadia seem like a game to relax with.  This is totally crazy after a minute or two, and this was on skill level 1.
